high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "spaceman.in." The post features a detailed map of the universe, highlighting various celestial structures such as galaxies, clusters, and voids. The map is labeled with names like "Cygnus Void," "Pavo-Indus Supercluster," "Virgo Supercluster," and "Centaurus Supercluster," among others. The text overlay on the image reads: "This Local Group is a part of the Supercluster known as the Virgo Super Cluster." This indicates that the Local Group, which includes our Milky Way galaxy, is situated within the larger Virgo
